💰 RawBT Example 06 - Cash Drawer Control

⚠️ Important: Cash drawer must be connected to the printer's RJ11/RJ12 port. Not all printers support cash drawer triggering.

Open Cash Drawer:

Methods:

// Method 1: Using job function job.openDrawer(); // Method 2: With parameters job.openDrawer(0, 50, 200); // pin, on-time, off-time // Method 3: Raw ESC/POS command job.raw([0x1B, 0x70, 0x00, 0x19, 0xFA]); // ESC p m t1 t2 // 0x1B 0x70 = Command // 0x00 = Pin 0 (or 0x01 for Pin 1) // 0x19 = On time (25ms × 25 = 625ms) // 0xFA = Off time (250ms × 250 = 62.5s)

ESC/POS Drawer Commands:

Command Bytes Description
ESC p 0 1B 70 00 19 FA Open drawer (Pin 0)
ESC p 1 1B 70 01 19 FA Open drawer (Pin 1)

Try Different Pins:

💡 Tip: If Pin 0 doesn't work, try Pin 1. Some cash drawers are connected to different pins.
